name: PEPAC planting of farm and non-farm land
conditions: Annex II of Portaria 124/2025/1: support 75–100% by beneficiary type (restantes beneficiários 75% outside disadvantaged areas — the rate kept here). Unit costs are a schedule by operation and slope in Aviso 01/C.3.2.1/2025 Annex I (€/ha or €/plant), not one cost_cap_eur_ha — leave that blank until slope bands are modelled. Fast-growth species (talhadia <20 years, Christmas trees, energy crops) ineligible — eucalyptus excluded. Maintenance and income-loss premiums are under C.3.2.8 (separate law; amounts not in 124/2025). Call 01/C.3.2.1/2025 closed 15 Sep 2025.
legal_text: Portaria n.º 124/2025/1 (Anexo II); Aviso 01/C.3.2.1/2025 (Anexo I unit costs)

conditions: Articles D156-6 to D156-11 (code forestier) say full-planting subsidies follow a national schedule set by ministerial order; they do not state a euro amount or a single %.
